attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter essay, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: Unhedged 'isn't coming' about future revenue is a firm forecast. The normalisation as expected generative AI revenue fits the investment context. No deadline or threshold is stated.

contract.note: The plain reading (revenue at the scale that would justify the investment, not literally zero sales) is ordinary and fair. Requiring an industry-wide comparison against contemporaneous expectations is reasonable, but the speaker supplied no measure.

evidence.note: Anthropic S-1, available 2026-10-26: about $16.3B realized revenue in H1 2026 against about $17.0B in operating expenses. Covers a single company and does not test industry-wide revenue against investment expectations.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast with no deadline. The packet has only one company's large realized revenue. That undercuts a literal reading, but it does not show whether industry revenue met the expectations behind the infrastructure investment, and nothing shows a definitive wind-down. Neither the support nor the contradiction condition is met.

attribution.note: Zitron's own sentence in his own essay.

semantics.note: 'Aren't going to get better' is unhedged. The Blackwell framing is kept. The earlier 'if we're truly at diminishing returns' sits in a separate paragraph; this sentence stands as a categorical forecast.

contract.note: The plain reading (no material capability gain from Blackwell-era models) is ordinary. The narrower pre-training reading is flagged. The capability-benchmark test with a pre-post baseline is fair.

evidence.note: Microsoft disclosure, available 2026-10-15: large GB200 (Blackwell) training run. Shows the hardware scenario happened. Its loss comparisons are against 2026 models, not a pre-post baseline.

MAI-Thinking-1 report, 2026-06-02: base model trained on GB200, 84.2% on the GPQA Diamond science benchmark (same 198-question set). Company evaluation; different grading and output budget limit exact comparability.
OpenAI, 2024-09-12: pre-post GPQA Diamond baseline of 77.3% for the research o1 model and 73.3% for o1-preview.

reviews.rationale: A dated Blackwell-trained Microsoft model reports 84.2% on GPQA Diamond. The best pre-post result was 77.3%. On the same benchmark subset, that is a material gain and meets the early-resolution rule. Caveats: the report is a company disclosure, grading and inference settings differ, and the gain is not isolated to pre-training. The contract admits these differences, so the categorical forecast is contradicted.
